news.n_waf_tlemcen: Merchants from the Maghreb say the eight-year siege of Tlemcen is over: the Marinid sultan was murdered in his own camp.
news.n_waf_granada_capital: Merchants from the Maghreb say the emir Muhammad ibn Nasr has made Granada his capital.
news.n_waf_kose_dag: News from the east: the Mongols have defeated the Seljuk sultan in Anatolia.
news.n_waf_ecija: The Marinid sultan has crossed into al-Andalus and defeated the Christians. Merchants celebrate.
news.n_waf_tripoli_syria: Sultan Qalawun has taken Tripoli in Syria from the Franks.
news.n_waf_khalil: In Egypt Sultan al-Ashraf Khalil, who took Acre, has been murdered.
news.n_waf_ghazan_damascus: They say the Mongol khan Ghazan has beaten the Mamluks and briefly occupied Damascus.
news.n_waf_almeria: The Christians besieged Algeciras and Almería, but the Muslims held out.
news.n_waf_dongola: Pilgrims say a Muslim king has been placed on the throne of Nubian Dongola, and its main church turned into a mosque.
news.n_waf_musa_prepares: They say Mansa Musa is preparing for the hajj and gathering gold from every province.
news.n_waf_ilkhanate: Merchants from the east say the last great Mongol khan of Persia has died, and his realm is falling apart.
news.n_waf_mossi_tbk: They say the Mossi have sacked and burned Timbuktu.
news.n_waf_embassy_fez: They say the mansa's envoys went to Fez with rich gifts for the Marinid sultan.
news.n_waf_battuta_home: The traveler from Tangier has returned to Fez and is telling the sultan's court about Mali.
news.n_waf_abu_inan: In Fez the Marinid sultan Abu Inan has been murdered.
news.n_waf_giraffe: They say the mansa sent the Marinid sultan a live giraffe as a gift. In Fez the whole city ran out to see it.
news.n_waf_muqaddima: The scholar Ibn Khaldun, in seclusion, has finished a great book on how kingdoms are born and die.
news.n_waf_musa2: Mansa Musa II has died. They say his vizier ran everything in his reign.
news.n_waf_barquq_back: Sultan Barquq has taken back power in Egypt.
news.n_waf_faraj: In Egypt Sultan Faraj, son of Barquq, has been killed.
news.n_waf_madeira: They say the Portuguese have found islands in the sea and are planting sugar cane there.
news.n_waf_spice: Merchants grumble that the sultan of Egypt has taken the whole pepper trade into his own hands.
news.n_waf_rio_de_oro: From the desert coast word comes that the strangers' boats have reached a bay they call the River of Gold.
news.n_waf_barsbay_dies: The Egyptian sultan Barsbay has died.
news.n_waf_mehmed2: Merchants say the Ottomans have a young new sultan, Mehmed.
news.n_waf_henry: They say the Portuguese prince who sent ships along the coasts of Africa has died.
news.n_waf_mossi_raids: The Mossi cavalry is raiding the lands along the river again.
news.n_waf_pilgrim_ship: Pilgrims are horrified: the Portuguese burned a ship in the Indian Ocean carrying pilgrims home from Mecca.
news.n_waf_rhodes: The Ottomans have taken the island of Rhodes from the Christian knights.
news.n_waf_goree: They say the Dutch have settled on the island of Gorée off Cape Verde.
news.n_waf_ming_falls: Far to the east, they say, the Ming dynasty of China has fallen.
news.n_waf_nasrid: Merchants from the Maghreb say that in al-Andalus the emir Muhammad ibn Nasr has raised his banner against the Christians and is gathering the last Muslim towns around him.
news.n_waf_sosso: They say that in the south, in the Mandinka country, a young chief named Sundiata has defeated Sumaoro, the dreaded king of Sosso.
news.n_waf_cordoba: Bitter news has come from across the desert: the Christians of Castile have taken Córdoba and turned its great mosque into a church.
news.n_waf_ghana: It is said the mansa's army has laid waste to what was left of the old capital of Ghana, once the richest kingdom of the Sahel.
news.n_waf_jerusalem: Pilgrims report that Jerusalem has been sacked by Khwarazmian horsemen fleeing the Mongols.
news.n_waf_seville: Merchants say Seville has fallen. Of Muslim al-Andalus only Granada remains.
news.n_waf_mamluks: A coup in Egypt: power has been seized by the Mamluks, the sultan's slave soldiers. They say they routed the Franks and captured their king.
news.n_waf_hafsid: The Hafsid ruler of Tunis has proclaimed himself caliph. Merchants from Tunis walk with their heads held high.
news.n_waf_sundiata: The griots sing laments: Mansa Sundiata, founder of the Mali empire, is dead.
news.n_waf_baghdad: Terrible news from Egypt: the Mongols have taken Baghdad and killed the caliph. The city of Islam's greatest scholars lies in ruins.
news.n_waf_ain_jalut: They say the Mamluks of Egypt have defeated the invincible Mongols at the Spring of Goliath. Merchants in Timbuktu and Gao give thanks to God.
news.n_waf_caliph_cairo: Sultan Baybars has received a fugitive of the Abbasid house in Cairo and proclaimed him caliph.
news.n_waf_uli_hajj: Mansa Uli, son of Sundiata, has gone to Mecca with a pilgrim caravan: the first ruler of Mali to make the hajj.
news.n_waf_antioch: Merchants report that Baybars has taken Antioch from the Franks.
news.n_waf_marinids: News from the Maghreb: the Almohad dynasty has fallen, and the Marinids have taken Marrakesh.
news.n_waf_tunis: They say the king of the Franks led an army against Tunis and died there of sickness. The army left with nothing.
news.n_waf_krak: Baybars has taken the Franks' impregnable fortress in the Syrian mountains. Merchants retell it in every market.
news.n_waf_nubia: They say a Mamluk army has gone up the Nile into Christian Nubia and set up a king of its own choosing there.
news.n_waf_baybars: Sultan Baybars, terror of the Franks and the Mongols, has died.
news.n_waf_song: Far to the east, they say, the Mongols have conquered the vast land of China, where silk and porcelain come from.
news.n_waf_japan: A strange tale goes round: a Mongol fleet sailing to the eastern islands was scattered by a storm.
news.n_waf_qalawun: In Cairo Sultan Qalawun has built a hospital where everyone is treated free: rich and poor, locals and strangers.
news.n_waf_sakura: They say that in Mali the throne has been seized by Sakura, a freedman of the court.
news.n_waf_acre: Acre has fallen. The Franks have been driven from the whole Syrian coast.
news.n_waf_ghazan: Merchants from the east say the Mongol khan Ghazan has embraced Islam, and his army with him.
news.n_waf_egypt_famine: Pilgrims tell of great hunger and pestilence in Egypt.
news.n_waf_sakura_dies: News has come: Mansa Sakura made the hajj but was killed on the way home.
news.n_waf_shaqhab: The Mamluks have beaten the Mongols in Syria again, at Marj al-Saffar.
news.n_waf_nasir_back: They say Sultan al-Nasir Muhammad has taken back power in Egypt.
news.n_waf_musa: The new mansa of Mali is Musa, son of Abu Bakr. They say he is pious and rich beyond compare.
news.n_waf_walata_road: Merchants say salt from Taghaza goes south through Walata, and the mansa's men guard the road.
news.n_waf_tegaza: They say that in Taghaza even the houses and the mosque are built of salt slabs, and water is brought from far away.
news.n_waf_cairo_gold: Word from Cairo: Mansa Musa has given away so much gold that its price has fallen there.
news.n_waf_djinguereber: In Timbuktu a great mosque is being built at Mansa Musa's command. The architect is the Andalusian al-Sahili.
news.n_waf_cairo_wonders: Merchants from Egypt tell of Cairo's wonders: stone mosques, markets of a thousand shops, books of every kind.
news.n_waf_musa_dies: Mansa Musa has died. The throne passed to his son Magha.
news.n_waf_salado: Merchants say that by the Salado river in al-Andalus the Christians have routed the army of the Marinid sultan.
news.n_waf_sulayman: Sulayman, Musa's brother, has become mansa.
news.n_waf_marinid_tunis: The Marinid sultan Abu al-Hasan has taken Tunis. They say he exchanged letters and gifts with the mansa.
news.n_waf_plague: Terrible news from across the desert: plague in Cairo and the towns of the Maghreb, with people dying in their thousands.
news.n_waf_plague_after: Caravans come less often: after the plague there is no one left in the Maghreb to carry on trade.
news.n_waf_battuta_set: They say a traveler from Tangier is setting out for Mali. He has already seen India and China.
news.n_waf_battuta_book: Merchants from Fez say the traveler Ibn Battuta has dictated a book about all his wanderings, Mali included.
news.n_waf_sulayman_dies: Mansa Sulayman has died. Strife has broken out at court.
news.n_waf_alexandria: Franks from the island of Cyprus have attacked Alexandria, looting and burning the city.
news.n_waf_ming: Far to the east, in China, the Mongols have been driven out, and new emperors rule there.
news.n_waf_timur: Merchants from the east speak of a new conqueror, lame Timur of Samarkand.
news.n_waf_mari_djata: They say Mansa Mari Djata died of the sleeping sickness: for two years he slept and would not wake.
news.n_waf_atlas: They say Christians on the island of Majorca have drawn a map of the world, and on it is the mansa of Mali holding a gold nugget.
news.n_waf_kano: Wangara merchants say their brethren have brought Islam to the Hausa town of Kano.
news.n_waf_barquq: In Egypt the Mamluk Barquq has seized power.
news.n_waf_bornu: Far to the east, by Lake Chad, the rulers of Kanem, hard pressed by enemies, have moved to Bornu and are building a new kingdom there.
news.n_waf_kosovo: Merchants say the Ottoman Turks have defeated the Christians on the Field of Kosovo.
news.n_waf_khaldun_cairo: The scholar Ibn Khaldun, a qadi in Cairo, questions merchants and pilgrims about Mali and writes down the history of its rulers.
news.n_waf_nicopolis: They say the Ottomans utterly destroyed a huge Frankish army at Nicopolis.
news.n_waf_delhi: Timur has sacked Delhi, the capital of the Indian sultans.
news.n_waf_damascus: Timur has taken and burned Damascus. Pilgrims tell of it in tears.
news.n_waf_ankara: Timur has defeated the Ottoman sultan Bayezid and taken him prisoner.
news.n_waf_timur_dies: Timur is dead. They say he was marching on China.
news.n_waf_khaldun_dies: Ibn Khaldun, the scholar who wrote the history of Mali's kings, has died in Cairo.
news.n_waf_tuareg_walata: Merchants complain that the Tuareg grow bolder in robbing caravans near Walata, and the mansa's men don't come to help.
news.n_waf_ceuta: News has come: the Portuguese have crossed the strait and taken Ceuta.
news.n_waf_china_ships: Merchants from the east tell of ships from China, huge as houses, that came to the shores of East Africa.
news.n_waf_barsbay: There's a new sultan in Egypt, Barsbay. They say he has taken the whole spice trade into the treasury.
news.n_waf_cyprus: The Mamluks have captured the king of Cyprus and brought him to Cairo.
news.n_waf_songhai_raids: They say the Songhai of Gao are coming up the river and plundering the lands of Mali.
news.n_waf_akil: Akil's Tuareg have occupied Timbuktu, and the mansa's men have left.
news.n_waf_tangier: They say the Portuguese tried to take Tangier and were beaten.
news.n_waf_captives: Troubling news from the desert coast: strangers in big boats are seizing people and carrying them away over the sea.
news.n_waf_senegal: They say the white men's boats have reached the mouth of the Senegal river.
news.n_waf_arguin: The Portuguese have built a fort on the island of Arguin off the desert coast, where they trade cloth for gold and slaves.
news.n_waf_constantinople: Great news: the Ottoman Turks have taken Constantinople, capital of the Rum.
news.n_waf_gambia: The strangers' boats have gone up the Gambia river. The mansa's vassals trade with them.
news.n_waf_cape_verde: They say the white men are setting up settlements on islands in the sea west of Cape Verde.
news.n_waf_rumfa: Muhammad Rumfa rules in Kano. They say he is building mosques and inviting scholars.
news.n_waf_sunni_ali: A new warrior rules in Gao: Sunni Ali.
news.n_waf_ali_raid: Sunni Ali has defeated the Fulani and is campaigning all along the bend of the Niger.
news.n_waf_timbuktu_falls: Sunni Ali has taken Timbuktu. Scholars are fleeing to Walata.
news.n_waf_qaitbay: Sultan Qaitbay rules in Egypt. Merchants praise him, and pilgrims praise his buildings in Mecca.
news.n_waf_gold_coast: They say the Portuguese have sailed to the Gold Coast, from where gold used to flow only north.
news.n_waf_djenne: Djenne has surrendered to Sunni Ali after a long siege.
news.n_waf_mossi_walata: Mossi cavalry rode all the way to Walata and plundered it.
news.n_waf_mehmed: The Ottoman sultan Mehmed, conqueror of Constantinople, has died.
news.n_waf_kobi: Sunni Ali has defeated the Mossi army and driven it south.
news.n_waf_benin: They say the white men from the sea have come to Benin and trade pepper and brass there.
news.n_waf_cape: Merchants say the Portuguese have sailed round the southernmost tip of Africa.
news.n_waf_kongo: Far to the south, they say, the king of Kongo has taken up the strangers' faith.
news.n_waf_granada: Granada, the last Muslim city of al-Andalus, has fallen. Exiles are fleeing to Fez and Tlemcen.
news.n_waf_askia: Gao has a new ruler: Askia Muhammad.
news.n_waf_askia_hajj: Askia Muhammad has left for Mecca with a huge caravan.
news.n_waf_maghili: The scholar al-Maghili from Tuat has come to the askia's court. They say he urges the ruler to be strict with those who mix Islam with the old customs.
news.n_waf_india: Merchants from Cairo are worried: Portuguese ships have sailed around Africa and reached India. The spices may bypass Egypt.
news.n_waf_safavid: Shah Ismail has taken the throne in Persia and demands that his subjects follow the Shia faith.
news.n_waf_borgu: The askia made war on Borgu. They say the army came back with heavy losses.
news.n_waf_diala: The askia's armies are fighting in the west, in lands that once belonged to Mali.
news.n_waf_leo: A young traveler from Fez stayed in Timbuktu. They say he marveled that books here sell for more than any other goods.
news.n_waf_katsina: They say the askia's army has marched on the Hausa towns of Katsina and Kano.
news.n_waf_agadez: The askia has subdued Agadez in the Air mountains and installed his own men there.
news.n_waf_ottoman_egypt: A great change: the Ottomans have defeated the Mamluks and taken Cairo. Now a Turkish sultan rules Egypt.
news.n_waf_kanta: Kanta, the ruler of Kebbi, refused to share the spoils with the askia and broke away from Songhai.
news.n_waf_suleiman: Merchants say there is a new sultan in Istanbul: Suleiman.
news.n_waf_fulani_west: From the west comes news of the Fulani of Koli Tengella: they have founded their own kingdom on the Senegal river.
news.n_waf_mughal: Far to the east, in India, they say a descendant of Timur has taken the throne.
news.n_waf_askia_out: Old Askia Muhammad has been deposed by his son Musa.
news.n_waf_gran: Pilgrims say that in Ethiopia the Muslim commander Ahmad Gran is routing the Christian kings.
news.n_waf_musa_killed: Askia Musa has been killed by his brothers. Gao is in turmoil again.
news.n_waf_envoy: They say envoys of the Portuguese king came to the mansa.
news.n_waf_tunis_charles: The Christian emperor has taken Tunis. Merchants from Tunis are fleeing south.
news.n_waf_ismail: Ismail has become askia. He brought his old father back from the island where he was held.
news.n_waf_askia_dies: Old Askia Muhammad has died and was buried in his tomb at Gao.
news.n_waf_ishaq: The new askia is Ishaq. They say he is harsh and greedy for tribute.
news.n_waf_algiers: The Christian emperor's fleet was wrecked by a storm off Algiers.
news.n_waf_gran_dies: Ahmad Gran has been killed in Ethiopia. The Portuguese helped the Christian king.
news.n_waf_niani_sacked: Songhai troops have sacked the capital of Mali.
news.n_waf_aqit: The qadi Mahmud, who judged the townspeople for half a century, has died in Timbuktu. The whole town mourned him.
news.n_waf_saadians: News from the Maghreb: the Saadians have taken Fez and now rule all Morocco.
news.n_waf_jolof: They say that in the west the Jolof kingdom has broken apart: its vassals no longer obey the king.
news.n_waf_tripoli: The Turks have taken Tripoli from the Christian knights.
news.n_waf_dawud: Merchants praise Askia Dawud: the roads are safe, and he himself buys books and gives them to scholars.
news.n_waf_ahmad_baba: In Araouane a boy has been born into the Aqit family. He will be called Ahmad Baba, and will become a great scholar.
news.n_waf_taghaza: The Moroccans have attacked Taghaza. Salt has grown dear.
news.n_waf_salt_cheap: The Tuareg have found new salt beds in the desert and bring salt around Taghaza.
news.n_waf_idris: Far to the east, in Bornu, Idris Alooma reigns. They say he has Turkish guns.
news.n_waf_malta: The Turks besieged the island of Malta but failed to take it.
news.n_waf_suleiman_dies: Sultan Suleiman, who ruled the Ottomans for nearly half a century, has died.
news.n_waf_granary: They say the askia's granaries hold so much grain that in a hungry year he feeds whole quarters.
news.n_waf_lepanto: In the sea off Greece the Christians have defeated the Ottoman fleet.
news.n_waf_tunis_ottoman: The Ottomans have taken Tunis for good.
news.n_waf_luanda: They say the Portuguese have built a town far to the south, in Angola.
news.n_waf_three_kings: A great battle in Morocco: the Portuguese king has been killed, and Ahmad al-Mansur has taken the throne.
news.n_waf_iberian: They say the Spanish king has become king of the Portuguese too.
news.n_waf_dawud_dies: Askia Dawud has died. His sons are quarreling over the throne.
news.n_waf_tuat: Ahmad al-Mansur has seized the oases of Tuat and Gurara on the caravan route to the Niger.
news.n_waf_taoudenni: The Moroccans have occupied Taghaza. Salt is now mined at Taoudenni, even deeper in the desert.
news.n_waf_ishaq2: After a revolt and a war between brothers, Ishaq II has become askia.
news.n_waf_judar: They say an army with firearms has set out from Marrakesh across the desert, led by Judar Pasha.
news.n_waf_tondibi: At Tondibi the Moroccans defeated the askia. Songhai has fallen.
news.n_waf_nuh: Askia Nuh fights on against the Moroccans in the marshes of Dendi.
news.n_waf_ahmad_baba_exile: They say Ahmad Baba and other scholars of Timbuktu have been brought to Marrakesh in chains.
news.n_waf_baba_freed: Ahmad Baba has been freed but not allowed to go home. In Marrakesh he teaches and writes books.
news.n_waf_jenne_battle: Mansa Mahmud tried to retake Djenne from the Moroccans and was defeated.
news.n_waf_mansur_dies: Sultan Ahmad al-Mansur has died. His sons are at war in Morocco, and the garrisons on the Niger have stopped listening to orders.
news.n_waf_moriscos: The Spanish king is expelling the last descendants of the Muslims of al-Andalus. The exiles are arriving in the Maghreb.
news.n_waf_baba_returns: Ahmad Baba has returned to Timbuktu after fifteen years in exile.
news.n_waf_arma: The Moroccan soldiers on the Niger no longer wait for pashas from Marrakesh but choose their own commanders.
news.n_waf_arma_wars: They say the arma soldiers are fighting among themselves for power in Timbuktu, while the Tuareg and Fulani plunder the countryside.
news.n_waf_baba_dies: Ahmad Baba, the greatest scholar of Timbuktu, has died.
news.n_waf_elmina_dutch: They say that on the Gold Coast the Dutch have taken the stone fort from the Portuguese.
news.n_waf_sadi: In Timbuktu the scholar al-Sadi is writing down the history of Songhai and its towns.
news.n_waf_saint_louis: They say the French have built a fort at the mouth of the Senegal river.
